t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Notice the algorithm of the gnomes, one gnome will give consistently more than the other, they come in four colors, if one gnome amount of mushrooms switches that means they all switched.

vb_textbox.text: During the game you will see a pair of gnomes. These gnomes will always come in a set of colors (red/yellow or blue/green for example). One or two of the gnomes will  give consistently more than the other, when you notice you aren't getting as much mushrooms from the gnome that was giving high rates, find another gnome that is giving higher rates. If there is a gnome that's not giving you any mushrooms avoid that gnome until you notice the rates switch again.
